Axiom: Scope Graph is a directed dependency graph. Rules: - Edge A→B means «scope A depends-on scope B»: A inherits B's effective rules in the cascade and may consume B's contracts. - Cycle in the graph → `H_CYCLE_IN_GRAPH` (abort). - scope-type constraints: `infrastructure` and `contracts` scopes are typically leaves (depend only on other infra / contracts). `product` and `library` scopes depend on infra + contracts. - The graph is rendered as a Mermaid `graph TD` block inside the Portal.
